structure: stand-up anecdote with plausible cartoon causality (KayfabeTip 1): the cyborg cop's first night on patrol in the body-city; each card is the next caused or twisted event (badger, subway, cats, mice, riot rats, salamander, K-9, spider, crab, hamster, archive, captain, owls, urchin); outro callback minigun / city fine without him
synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck that describes the human body as a city. It is performed by a small armored police cyborg on patrol through that city, for whoever happens to be there.
bestOfReason: 1, 2: the city runs itself, the citizen was never asked.
11, 17, 19: his own unit heals, burns, bites itself.
15, 18: the real threats are inside; the spider has the better record.
31, 20: emergency mode as normal; training from his teens.
21, 23, 24, 30: looking beats the book; the institution rejects the finding; the quack stays on the payroll.
6: no manager, only a press secretary (pays off the opening).

orderReason: Patrol order: district, departments, alarm (immune → inflammation → autoimmune), inside threats (DNA → cancer), training (thymus), cold cases, method (blind eye), memo (brain), score.

songLineChanges.songLine: The decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it.
The Lungs: seventy square meters folded into your chest.
Eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain.

cues.cue: police radio squelch on the backbeat

beats: The Biological Metropolis: a city that runs itself, and a cop who thinks it's his.
First night on the job they gave me a minigun and a district: you.

beats.text: The City Inside: it has been running the civilization while you were busy thinking about other things. You are the other things.

beats.pre: So I ask who's in charge. Nobody:
beats.text: The Citizen: you have never once told this city what to do. It has never once asked your permission.

beats.pre: Fine. I start with a noise complaint in the boiler room:
beats.text: The Heart: the brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.

beats.pre: I try to unplug the badger and everything goes blue, so they show me the one switch I'm allowed to touch:
beats.text: The Lungs: the only autonomic function with a manual override.

beats.pre: Back on my feet, I chase a suspect into the subway:
beats.text: The Gut, zombie commuters boarding: eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city.

beats.pre: The subway dumps me at the water works, where two cats test everything that floats by:
beats.text: The Kidneys: the original doping agency.

beats.pre: At midnight the lights go out and mice in overalls mop up my evidence:
beats.text: The Night Shift: sleep is not rest. It is the janitorial shift washing the thoughts out of the carpet.
The Immune System, armored rats with riot shields: a library of every murder attempt. It remembers things you have forgotten.

beats.pre: They find one splinter and set the block on fire:
beats.text: Inflammation: the response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.

beats.pre: The fire spooks our police dog:
beats.text: Autoimmune, crazed dog biting itself: the gun works fine; it's just pointed the wrong way.

beats.pre: Meanwhile, in the copy room, a spider eats the typos:
beats.text: DNA Replication: one error per billion letters. You have had cancer many times; the spider usually eats it.

beats.pre: One night the spider takes a break:
beats.text: Cancer, giant crab with fortress built on shell: it is not a disease; it is a competitor.
The Cortisol Architect, hamster in tie drowning in alarm clocks: the comfort zone is a chemical state.

beats.pre: I dig through the archive for answers:
beats.text: Andreas Vesalius: he looked at the body instead of the book. Everyone else was wrong.

beats.pre: Next file, a man who washed his hands:
beats.text: Ignaz Semmelweis: he saved the mothers. The doctors committed him.

beats.pre: I take both files to the captain:
beats.text: The Semmelweis Problem: the evidence is available. The implication is uncomfortable. We reject the finding.

beats.pre: Turns out the captain has his own method:
beats.text: The Humoralist: wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe.

beats.pre: So I go over his head, straight to the top floor:
beats.text: The Brain, five owls in judge wigs: the decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it. You are the press secretary, not the president.
The Scorekeeper, sea urchin writing with feather quill: the body keeps the score because the body is the score.

beats: End of shift: minigun still loaded, city still fine without me.
